title: RESIZE HATCH ONLY ON HOVER
why: Critic on the raid HUD (10-18): hatched resize grips on every panel are clutter. The style guide says chrome shows only when used. The hatch now draws only while the pointer is over its panel.
now: The raid HUD panels show their resize hatch only when the pointer is over them.
